arxiv-1410-3797.title: The Effect of Nonlinear Landau Damping on Ultrarelativistic Beam Plasma Instabilities
arxiv-1410-3797.creator: Philip Chang, Avery E. Broderick, Christoph Pfrommer, Ewald Puchwein, Astrid Lamberts, Mohamad Shalaby
arxiv-1410-3797.description: Abstract Very-high energy gamma-rays from extragalactic sources pair-produce off of the extragalactic background light, yielding an electron-positron pair beam. This pair beam is unstable to various plasma instabilities, especially the “oblique” instability, which can be the dominant cooling mechanism for the beam.

arxiv-1812-11743.title: The Burnside Problem for Locally Compact Groups Thanks: Thibaut Dumont has been supported by the Academy of Finland (grant 288501 ‘ Geometry of subRiemannian groups ’) and the European Research Council (ERC Starting Grant 713998 GeoMeG ‘ Geometry of Metric Groups ’), P.I. Enrico Le Donne. Thanks: Th
arxiv-1812-11743.creator: Thibaut Dumont, Thibault Pillon
arxiv-1812-11743.description: Abstract . Using topological notions of translation-like actions introduced by Schneider, we give a positive answer to a geometric version of Burnside problem for locally compact group. The main theorem states that a locally compact group is non-compact if and only if it admits a translation-like action by the group of integers 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} .

arxiv-2006-03737.title: A zero-inflated gamma model for deconvolved calcium imaging traces
arxiv-2006-03737.creator: Xue-Xin Wei, Ding Zhou, Andres Grosmark, Zaki Ajabi, Fraser Sparks, Pengcheng Zhou, Mark Brandon, Attila Losonczy, Liam Paninski
arxiv-2006-03737.description: Abstract Calcium imaging is a critical tool for measuring the activity of large neural populations. Much effort has been devoted to developing “pre-processing” tools for calcium video data, addressing the important issues of e.g. , motion correction, denoising, compression, demixing, and deconvolution. However, statistical modeling of deconvolved calcium signals (i.e.

arxiv-2208-10607.title: Individual Tree Detection in Large-Scale Urban Environments using High-Resolution Multispectral Imagery Journal: International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation
arxiv-2208-10607.creator: Jonathan Ventura, Camille Pawlak, Milo Honsberger, Cameron Gonsalves, Julian Rice, Natalie L.R. Love, Skyler Han, Viet Nguyen, Keilana Sugano, Jacqueline Doremus, G. Andrew Fricker, Jenn Yost, Matt Ritter
arxiv-2208-10607.description: Abstract Systematic maps of urban forests are useful for regional planners and ecologists to understand the spatial distribution of trees in cities. However, manually-created urban forest inventories are expensive and time-consuming to create and typically don’t provide coverage of private land.

arxiv-2305-03548.title: Noise calibration for the stochastic rotating shallow water model
arxiv-2305-03548.creator: Dan Crisan, Oana Lang, Alexander Lobbe, Peter Jan van Leeuwen, Roland Potthast
arxiv-2305-03548.description: Abstract Stochastic partial differential equations have been used in a variety of contexts to model the evolution of uncertain dynamical systems. In recent years, their applications to geophysical fluid dynamics has increased massively. For a judicious usage in modelling fluid evolution, one needs to calibrate the amplitude of the noise to data.

arxiv-2307-06040.title: Rhythm Modeling for Voice Conversion
arxiv-2307-06040.creator: Benjamin van Niekerk, Marc-André Carbonneau, Herman Kamper
arxiv-2307-06040.description: Abstract Voice conversion aims to transform source speech into a different target voice. However, typical voice conversion systems do not account for rhythm, which is an important factor in the perception of speaker identity. To bridge this gap, we introduce Urhythmic—an unsupervised method for rhythm conversion that does not require parallel data or text transcriptions.

arxiv-2308-11050.title: Optimal Dorfman Group Testing for Symmetric Distributions
arxiv-2308-11050.creator: Nicholas C. Landolfi, Sanjay Lall
arxiv-2308-11050.description: Abstract We study Dorfman’s classical group testing protocol in a novel setting where individual specimen statuses are modeled as exchangeable random variables. We are motivated by infectious disease screening. In that case, specimens which arrive together for testing often originate from the same community and so their statuses may exhibit positive correlation.

arxiv-2311-18622.title: Modelling Einstein cluster using Einasto profile
arxiv-2311-18622.creator: Ritwik Acharyya, Pritam Banerjee, Sayan Kar
arxiv-2311-18622.description: Abstract We demonstrate a general relativistic approach to model dark matter halos using the Einstein cluster, with the matter stress-energy generated by collisionless particles moving on circular geodesics in all possible angular directions and orbital radii. Such matter, as is known, allows an anisotropic pressure profile with non-zero tangential but zero radial pressure.

arxiv-2410-16257.title: Elucidating the design space of language models for image generation
arxiv-2410-16257.creator: Xuantong Liu, Shaozhe Hao, Xianbiao Qi, Tianyang Hu, Jun Wang, Rong Xiao, Yuan Yao
arxiv-2410-16257.description: Abstract The success of autoregressive (AR) language models in text generation has inspired the computer vision community to adopt Large Language Models (LLMs) for image generation. However, considering the essential differences between text and image modalities, the design space of language models for image generation remains underexplored.

arxiv-2504-16703.title: Decidability Problems for Micro-Stipula
arxiv-2504-16703.creator: G. Delzanno, C. Laneve, A. Sangnier, G. Zavattaro
arxiv-2504-16703.description: Abstract Micro- Stipula is a stateful calculus in which clauses can be activated either through interactions with the external environment or by the evaluation of time expressions. Despite the apparent simplicity of its syntax and operational model, the combination of state evolution, time reasoning, and nondeterminism gives rise to significant analytical challenges.

arxiv-2509-24776.title: VTPerception-R1: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning via Explicit Visual and Textual Perceptual Grounding
arxiv-2509-24776.creator: Yizhuo Ding, Mingkang Chen, Zhibang Feng, Tong Xiao, Wanying Qu, Wenqi Shao, Yanwei Fu
arxiv-2509-24776.description: Abstract Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to ground reasoning in perceptual evidence. We present a systematic study of perception strategies—explicit, implicit, visual, and textual—across four multimodal benchmarks and two MLLMs. Our findings show that explicit perception, especially when paired with textual cues, consistently yields the best improvements, particularly for smaller models.

britannica-1911-spielhagen-friedrich-von.description: Article 'Spielhagen, Friedrich von' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. novelist, was born at Magdeburg on the 24th of February 1829. He was brought up at Stralsund, where his father was in 1835 appointed government architect; he attended the gymnasium there, and studied law, and subsequently literature and philosophy, at the universities of Berlin, Bonn and Greifswald.

pmc-10675488.title: Characterizing Mechanical Properties of Layered Engineered Wood Using Guided Waves and Genetic Algorithm
pmc-10675488.creator: Nemish Atreya, Pai Wang, Xuan Zhu, Yuan Yao, Gilbert-Rainer Gillich
pmc-10675488.description: This study develops a framework for determining the material parameters of layered engineered wood in a nondestructive manner. The motivation lies in enhancing nondestructive evaluation (NDE) and quality assurance (QA) for engineered wood or mass timber, promising construction materials for sustainable and resilient civil structures.

pmc-11319361.title: NRP1 knockdown inhibits the invasion and migration of rhabdoid tumor of the kidney cells
pmc-11319361.creator: Bin Yamaoka, Eri Nagasaki-Maeoka, Shota Uekusa, Eri Muto-Fujita, Naoko Abe, Kyoko Fujiwara, Tsugumichi Koshinaga, Shuichiro Uehara
pmc-11319361.description: PurposeThe aim of this study was to detect candidate oncogenes of rhabdoid tumor of the kidney (RTK) and evaluate their roles in RTK in vitro.MethodsAn integrated analysis of messenger RNA (mRNA) and microRNA (miRNA) sequencing was performed to determine the expression profile of exosome-derived miRNAs and mRNAs in human RTK-derived cell lines and a human embryonic renal cell line.

pmc-11354487.title: The Role of the Gut Microbiota in Sanfilippo Syndrome’s Physiopathology: An Approach in Two Affected Siblings
pmc-11354487.creator: Raquel Barbero-Herranz, María Garriga-García, Ana Moreno-Blanco, Esther Palacios, Pedro Ruiz-Sala, Saioa Vicente-Santamaría, Sinziana Stanescu, Amaya Belanger-Quintana, Guillem Pintos-Morell, Beatriz Arconada, Rosa del Campo, José Avendaño-Ortiz, Gabriele Deidda, Massimo Pierucci, Anna Cavaccini
pmc-11354487.description: Sanfilippo syndrome, or mucopolysaccharidosis type III (MPS III), is a rare lysosomal disease caused by congenital enzymatic deficiencies in heparan sulfate (HS) degradation, leading to organ dysfunction. The most severe hallmark of MPS III comprises neurological alterations, although gastrointestinal symptoms (GISs) have also been shown to be relevant in many patients.

pmc-13137831.title: Multi‐Targeting Non‐Specific Genome Engineering in Bacteria
pmc-13137831.creator: Runze Sun, Ruixiang You, Yiwen Zhou, Huiyan He, Wenfang Wang, Xudong Qu, Yinhua Lu, Lei Li
pmc-13137831.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Genome engineering plays a crucial role in the rapidly growing fields of metabolic engineering and synthetic biology. Chromosomal integration and stable expression of functional genes or large metabolic pathways necessitate the development of host‐independent enabling technologies in diverse bacteria.

pmc-13257199.title: Deciphering the Pleiotropic Role of ARID1a and RIF1 in Endometrioid Ovarian Cancer
pmc-13257199.creator: Pawel Kordowitzki, Renata Voltolini Velho, Sandra Bock, Jalid Sehouli, Sylvia Mechsner
pmc-13257199.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Endometrioid ovarian cancer exhibited significantly reduced BAF250a/ARID1a protein expression and increased RIF1 expression.Specific oncogenic mutations, including BRCA1 and LAMB3, were significantly associated with altered ARID1a or RIF1 expression. What are the implications of the main findings? RIF1 expression demonstrated significant predictive value for platinum- and taxane-based treatment response.

pmc-13401998.title: Sex-Specific Mechanisms of Central Sensitization: A Narrative Review of the Neuroimmune Architecture of Chronic Pain
pmc-13401998.creator: Diogo Andrade Pereira
pmc-13401998.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Chronic pain disproportionately affects women, yet analgesic development has been built predominantly on male biological substrates, reflecting a now-refuted assumption of biological symmetry that excluded female subjects from preclinical investigation. Central sensitization, the pathological amplification of central nervous system signalling that produces pain hypersensitivity, is increasingly recognized as a sex-dependent neuroimmune phenomenon with distinct cellular and molecular signatures in males and females.

pmc-13440254.title: Ferroptosis spreading through propagative signals
pmc-13440254.creator: Saloni K Hombalkar, Jyotirekha Das, Michael Overholtzer
pmc-13440254.description: Ferroptosis is a regulated mechanism of cell death caused by the uncontrolled peroxidation of cellular lipids that has an unusual ability to propagate or spread between cells. Here, we review studies identifying regulators of ferroptosis propagation to consider a working model that might explain this unusual feature.

pmc-13527791.title: Effects of Nurse-Led Preoperative Visit on Postoperative Pain and Recovery among Surgical Patients in Nigeria: A Quasi-experimental Study
pmc-13527791.creator: Demilade Raqeebat Gbadamosi, Lucia Yetunde Ojewale
pmc-13527791.description: Background:Surgical patients' attitudes and perceptions of pain often impact their post-surgical pain experience and treatment effectiveness. Inadequate education and unclear postoperative pain expectations have been associated with heightened pain perception. The objective of this study was to assess the effects of perioperative nurse pre-visits on the pain and recovery level of surgical patients.

pmc-13547465.title: Perceived community environment and depressive symptoms among older adults in China: a cross-sectional analysis of physical activity as a moderator
pmc-13547465.creator: Zhijia Du, Junyue Yue, Zirui Lin, Xiaoyu Han
pmc-13547465.description: IntroductionPerceived community environment is an important contextual factor related to depressive symptoms in later life. However, few studies have examined whether physical activity (PA), a modifiable behavioral factor, moderates this association, particularly across specific aspects of perceived community environment and different types of PA.MethodsThis study used data from the 2023 China Longitudinal Aging Social Survey, including 9,410 older adults.

pmc-13636613.title: Characterization and immunogenicity of nanoparticle vaccines displaying embecovirus spike proteins
pmc-13636613.creator: Peter J. Halfmann, Augustine Duffy, Alex Wee, Noah Anderson, Jackson Terrell, Yoshihiro Kawaoka, Ravi S. Kane

pmc-13641084.title: Expanding continuous glucose monitoring’s potential from real-time safety to lifestyle support in type 1 diabetes exercise: a proof-of-concept study among adults with low baseline exercise levels
pmc-13641084.creator: Young In Chung, Garrett I. Ash, Sangchoon Jeon, Reshma Ramachandran, Matthew Stults-Kolehmainen, Elias K Spanakis, Lisa M. Fucito
pmc-13641084.description: Objective:This proof-of-concept study sought to explore how data from CGM and exercise can be aggregated and analyzed to capture clinically meaningful glycemic patterns and actionable feedback. To this end, we examined how exercise days were associated with glucose outcomes derived from continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) among adults with type 1 diabetes (T1D) who had low baseline exercise levels.

pmc-13677131.title: Multimodal Ayurveda Intervention in the Management of Recurrent Pilonidal Sinus: A Case Report
pmc-13677131.creator: Wicramanayake WAAP, Peshala KKVS, Semonti Nandi
pmc-13677131.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pilonidal sinus (PNS) is a chronic inflammatory condition that primarily originates from hair follicles in the natal cleft at the base of the spine and may also occur in other areas such as the axilla and umbilicus. A 25‐year‐old male patient presented to the outpatient department (OPD) of the surgery unit at the National Ayurveda Teaching Hospital, Borella, in November 2022 with complaints of pain and purulent discharge from the sacral region near the anus, accompanied by intermittent fever for 5 days.
